title: mni tag points
explanation:
### Description

Write and read MNI tag points with labels, display with glyphs and label placement.

**dataset → input → filter → visual_asset → renderer → infrastructure → output**

- [vtkActor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkActor.html) — assigns the mapped geometry to the scene.
- [vtkActor2D](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkActor2D.html) — actor2d.
- [vtkDataSetMapper](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkDataSetMapper.html) — maps any dataset type to graphics primitives.
- [vtkDoubleArray](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkDoubleArray.html) — double array.
- [vtkGlyph3D](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkGlyph3D.html) — places oriented, scaled glyphs at each point.
- [vtkLabelPlacementMapper](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkLabelPlacementMapper.html) — label placement mapper.
- [vtkMNITagPointReader](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkMNITagPointReader.html) — mni tag point reader.
- [vtkMNITagPointWriter](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkMNITagPointWriter.html) — mni tag point writer.
- [vtkPointSetToLabelHierarchy](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPointSetToLabelHierarchy.html) — point set to label hierarchy.
- [vtkPointSource](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPointSource.html) — generates random points inside a sphere.
- [vtkSphereSource](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkSphereSource.html) — generates a tessellated sphere.
- [vtkStringArray](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkStringArray.html) — string array.
- [vtkTextProperty](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkTextProperty.html) — text property.
- [vtkTransform](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkTransform.html) — defines a 4x4 geometric transformation.
- [vtkTransformFilter](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkTransformFilter.html) — applies a geometric transformation to a dataset.
- [vtkRenderWindow](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindow.html) — displays the rendered scene in a window on screen.
- [vtkRenderWindowInteractor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindowInteractor.html) — captures mouse and keyboard events.
- [vtkRenderer](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderer.html) — assembles the scene and configures the camera.
- `Initialize()` and `Start()` launch the interactive visualization — `Initialize()` prepares the interactor and `Start()` begins the event loop.
